spec.name: Orange Pets unicorn pearl
spec.description: A tiny pearl-white unicorn pony with a pale pink stepped mane and tail, grey hooves, two front-facing eyes and one short ivory-gold horn. Its flat forward crown remains clear for small hats.

prompt: Create an original a tiny elegant unicorn pony with pearl-white coat, soft pale pink mane and flowing stepped tail, four short legs with pale grey hooves, two small ears and ONE short ivory-gold horn on the rear half of the forehead. A blocky horse muzzle, no antlers or wings. Its single horn must remain recognisable. Compact vanilla Minecraft companion, feet y=0, centre x=z=8, face negative Z, height about 10-14 units, 16 units per block. Under 26 purposeful cubes and 14 bones. Main torso bone named body and main head bone named head, with broad cuboids. Leg bone names contain front or rear (phoenix legs use rear). Ear elements contain ear, horns contain horn and crest pieces contain crest. Head top front half must be flat and clear to fit small hats: ears, horns and crest go on the rear half, leaving a broad clear forehead ledge. Exactly TWO symmetrically placed eyes, spaced evenly from outer edges; no duplicate side eyes or eyes on back. Integer cube-net UV sizes, explicit integer uvSize for fractional geometry. One pixel atlas, subtle restrained vanilla pixel shading. Every element belongs to the connected rig. No accessories, props or detached effects. No intersecting coplanar faces or z-fighting. Anatomical overlaps only at true joints.
